notes.title: Patch v1
notes.content:
🚀 Patch v1 Release Notes


🆕 New Features & Content
🎮 Mission Beacon – Added a Launchable Beacon to Arm Controller to clearly 
indicate next Objective.
🛠 Mech Crane NeuraLink Connection – Can now connect and control crane.
🔧 Improvements & Tweaks
✅ Improved Arm Controller to make it more intuitive.
🎨 Enhanced visuals - Retro feel Wall Posters added to give more information to assist with Objective solving.
🎵 Updated sound effects and music for better immersion.
🐞 Bug Fixes
🛠 Fixed an issue where Astra will not take the Pod to the station before you.
🚀 Optimized performance to reduce lag/stuttering.
📢 Known Issues & Workarounds
⚠ Some players may experience getting stuck in walls. Working on a fix!
🔄 Temporary workaround: Please restart level (Progress will be saved).
💡 Feedback & Community
Your feedback helps us improve! Let us know what you think in the Steam Discussions or on https://discord.gg/Nw5kKFvh
